findings.note: Listed as a House co-patron (not chief patron) of HB 158, firearm locking device required for sale or transfer of firearm. As passed by the House, it makes it a Class 3 misdemeanor for a licensed dealer, manufacturer or importer to sell or transfer a firearm to anyone else without providing a locking device and a warning about children's access (summary: https://lis.virginia.gov/cgi-bin/legp604.exe?241+sum+HB158). Date is the prefiling date.

Listed as a House co-patron (not chief patron) of HJ 76, which directs the Joint Legislative Audit and Review Commission to conduct a two-year study of the social, physical, emotional and economic effects of gun violence on communities (summary: https://lis.virginia.gov/cgi-bin/legp604.exe?241+sum+HJ76).
